text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaat?!
*I'm* gonna be the narrator for the Shundai Festival?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. The autumn festival to pray for the safety of all Umamusume, the 'Shundai Festival'...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
They'd like Inari-san to perform the opening
'Tales of the Ancient Umamusume'
with all due dignity and poise.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Prestigious, huh... Guess standard Edo slang won't cut it.
Still...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Of course I can! But in exchange,
you're getting up on that stage with me, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: M-Me too?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
――Understood. If you'll permit me,
I would be honored to assist.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Inari One and Yaeno Muteki ended up hosting a "Tales of Ancient Umamusume" booth at the Shundai Festival.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Have you heard the tale? Of the Umamusume born across the great ocean... the 'Child of the Reef'?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
This is truly the one. The figure galloping
through fertile rice fields—wild, yet swift.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Oh, I am the "Child of the Reef." —A descendant of the Millstone Folk!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With Inari One as the storyteller and Yaeno Muteki as the performer,
the duo actually made quite a good match.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, the content was far too old-fashioned, and the audience's reaction was lackluster. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Howevvver! That child who stepped forth to race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Refusing to accept defeat like this,
she dashed off lickety-split!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Eh... Inari-san?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Charging headlong toward the hill! A steep descent just like Hiyodorigoe!
Just like that, leavin' all the other Umamusume in the dust!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The lines are... according to the script...
But her tone of voice is...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
From the "Scion of the Reef" to the "Swift-Footed Young Miss"!
Declaring she'll show the world how it's done, she boldly leaped straight to the front!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Oooooo!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Way to go, Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Hear, hear, House of Inari!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One suddenly switches her tone of voice. Instantly, the venue erupts in excitement.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Straight on to a victory cheer!
...Or so we thought, but it's a trap~!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: "The moment she seized the lead... from beneath her feet came the sad snapping sound of the end..."

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The rest of her life, withered like pampas grass...
As for what happened to the "Idaten Young Lady" after crossing over to a distant island nation...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...Not a chance! I refuse to let it end like this. Even if I can't run on my own two legs...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Let's bring the run of the stone mill to this island nation!
Ah, I mean, let's spread it far and wide~!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: Hear, hear, House of Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of Yaeno Muteki.
Adapting her tone on the fly to match Inari One,
she wraps things up brilliantly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And thus, the performance ended in great success.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I wasn't sure how it would turn out,
but it really got lively, didn't it, Inari-san?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If we left it like that,
it would've been a total ghost town and a complete buzzkill.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Hey Trainer, how was our performance out there?
choice_data_list: I could feel the Umamusume's feelings coming through.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: A person of many talents, huh... Well, you don't see traditional storytelling like koudan much these days anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Koudan storytelling. What Inari One demonstrated
was truly a traditional performing art passed down from Edo.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
The crowd wasn't getting hype at all, so I thought,
'Ah, screw it!' and went for it—and it was a smash hit!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Talk about a skill coming in handy!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Although their manner of speaking was unique,
even so, the way of life of the ancient Umamusume was—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that reached everyone's hearts.
As expected of you, Inari-san.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Thanks to Inari One's signature traditional performance, the night of the Shundai Festival was a huge hit.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Did the feelings of the "Swift Miss"
resonate loud and clear with ya?!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I am glad to hear that. While performing, I felt
as if I had truly assimilated with the ancient Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's strange, isn't it? Even though I put on quite an exaggerated act to match Inari's energy... it felt almost like...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Maybe that "Swift-Footed Lady"
was really like that deep down all along.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, can't just stand around!
Now that we've hyped things up,
next I'm gonna nail the sacred horse role too!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: The festival's not over yet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, completely carried away by the mood, Inari One ran through the festival night and put on quite a show.
